name: After Hours #41 — Awning and Two Wheels
description: A bike waiting out the weather. The awning does what roofs do, only smaller. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 41 is unlimited: anyone can mint this still. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever.
